create_get_audio_duration: get the duration of an audio array in seconds given a numpy array and sample rate
create_normalize_audio: normalize audio data to a target channel configuration using an AudioSpec with channel reduction support
create_resample_audio_pyav: resample audio from one sample rate to another using PyAV via FFmpeg libswresample
create_AudioResampler: create an AudioResampler instance that resamples audio to a target sample rate using pyav or scipy
create_split_audio: split long audio into overlapping chunks at low-energy regions to minimize cutting through speech
